name: Tiamat
description: (Tag:draconic)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:titanic-size)(Character)Tiamat is Beast II, the Mother of All Life, with unmatched physical and magical power. She creates and controls the Sea of Life, a black conceptual mud that remakes consumed organisms into her children; while it exists she lacks the concept of Death and has virtually unlimited magic, and she can recreate it while she lives. She can also rewrite local reality with Nega-Genesis to deny anything evolved from base humanity like myths and gods.
